description: This PHP source file defines a class 'InstanceAPI' within the OrangeHRM system that handles REST API requests related to installation instance data. It manages POST requests to store new instance information and GET requests to retrieve existing data, including validation of input parameters such as organization name, country code, language code, and timezone.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles installation instance data via POST and GET HTTP methods, performing validation and storage of organization, country, language, and timezone information.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save installation instance data, validating required fields and returning error responses if validation fails.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored installation instance data, formatting it with associated country, language, and timezone info.
